A.claim: The linear form z log C - y log B from the size window equals log(1 + A^x/B^y) identically, so it carries no information beyond the ratio of the summands and yields no new obstruction. Combining the M3 size window with the M1 congruence sieve gives a ~17x search reduction.

B.claim: Base order forces exponent order in any Beal counterexample: C largest base implies z <= max(x,y); C smallest base implies z > max(x,y); C <= B implies z > y.
